## What’s implemented

This is now a **Swiggy-inspired frontend demo** with a working sample food-ordering flow. It doesn’t depend on Swiggy’s unstable API.

### Home page and navigation
- Orange Swiggy-style hero, logo, and service banners.
- Navigation to Restaurants, Instamart, Dineout, and Cart.
- Home-page search for restaurants, cuisines, and dishes.
- Responsive layouts and labeled search inputs.

### Restaurant discovery
- Restaurant cards backed by local sample data.
- Search by restaurant name, cuisine, or dish.
- Filter by cuisine and minimum rating.
- Sort by rating or estimated delivery time.
- Category cards can show matching local restaurants.

### Menus and dish search
- Six sample restaurants with menus and dish details.
- Menu sections can be expanded or collapsed.
- Veg and non-veg filters.
- Search for dishes within a restaurant’s menu.
- Sample dish prices, descriptions, and ratings.

### Cart and checkout
- Add items, increase/decrease quantities, remove items, or clear the cart.
- Adding an item already in the cart increases its quantity.
- Cart badge shows the total item count.
- Cart contents persist in the current browser using `localStorage`.
- Checkout validates name, 10-digit phone number, and delivery address.
- Displays an estimated total with a flat delivery fee and 5% estimated tax.
- Placing the demo order shows an order confirmation and clears the cart.

### Other sections
- Grocery categories and Dineout listings/details use locally bundled data. Grocery product listings and purchases aren’t implemented yet.

## Where the data comes from

- Restaurants and menus: local sample data in [LocalRestaurantData.js](</C:/Users/anami/Downloads/Swiggy-Project/Swiggy-Project/src/Utils/LocalRestaurantData.js>).
- Grocery categories: [Grocery.js](</C:/Users/anami/Downloads/Swiggy-Project/Swiggy-Project/src/Utils/Grocery.js>).
- Dineout sample listings: [DineData.js](</C:/Users/anami/Downloads/Swiggy-Project/Swiggy-Project/src/Utils/DineData.js>).
- Cart state and persistence: [CartSlicer.js](</C:/Users/anami/Downloads/Swiggy-Project/Swiggy-Project/src/Stored/CartSlicer.js>) and [stores.js](</C:/Users/anami/Downloads/Swiggy-Project/Swiggy-Project/src/Stored/stores.js>).

The app **does not fetch live Swiggy restaurant/menu data**. Some existing grocery and Dineout images are remote URLs, so those images require an internet connection; the sample restaurant and menu content itself is local.

## Important demo limitations

- Checkout is a simulation: no payment is taken, and no actual delivery is placed.
- Delivery details and order history aren’t saved; only the cart persists in browser storage.
- There’s no login, backend, or real-time restaurant availability.
- Grocery product search and adding groceries to the cart aren’t implemented.

A production build completed successfully. Setup and feature notes are in [README.md](</C:/Users/anami/Downloads/Swiggy-Project/Swiggy-Project/README.md>).
